context: Ren and Asuka discuss data presentation.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: research discussion; vocabulary (示す/単純/意図/比較的/限界) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: このデータ、どう示せばいいですか?
lines.en: How should I present this data?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 単純なグラフで、示すといいですよ。
lines.en: Show it with a simple graph.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 比較的、分かりやすくなりますか?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、比較的、誤解が減ります。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: グラフの限界も、ありますか?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 限界があるので、言葉も添えましょう。
lines.en: There are limits, so add words too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 意図を、はっきり示したいです。
lines.en: I want to clearly show my intent.
lines.style: resolved young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 単純に、意図を示すのが一番ですね。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
